source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of built-in data structures (PDF 50).

blocks.text: Python kai built-in data structures deti hai jo data ko organized (tarteeb se) rakhne aur us par kaam karne ke liye zaroori hain. In mein lists, tuples aur dictionaries shamil hain; har ek ki apni features (khoobiyan) hain jo alag alag qism ke data aur aam operations ke liye kaam aati hain.

blocks.prompt: Python ke teen built-in data structures bataiye.

items: Built-in data structures: list, tuple, dictionary.
